devices.name: Astrolabe LunaSay
devices.role: moon, astrology, and symbolic reflection companion

devices.name: Astrolabe Ocarina
devices.role: breath, music, and playable sound companion

devices.name: Astrolabe Cameo
devices.role: memory, faculty, quotes, and keepsake companion

devices.name: Astrolabe Enso
devices.role: focus, readiness, and calm attention companion

devices.name: Astrolabe Luopan
devices.role: direction, bearing, and spatial alignment companion

steps.text: House lights down. Place every variant face-up in a semicircle, Pocket at stage left and Luopan at stage right.

steps.label: opening tableau
steps.stage: All devices settle on their home clock face.

steps.label: shared hello
steps.text: I am $name. My Castalia voice is $facultyName. In this tour, I am the $role.

steps.label: pocket time
steps.text: Pocket keeps time close to the body. I am for quick glances, errands, and small rituals that should not become another phone session.
steps.stage: Presenter lifts Pocket briefly, then returns it to the table.

steps.label: lunasay speaks
steps.text: LunaSay turns the moon, chart, and symbolic faces into a quiet desk ritual. I answer best when the room wants reflection, timing, and pattern.

steps.label: lunasay swipe to chart
steps.stage: Stage direction: swipe LunaSay left from Moon toward the next symbolic face.

steps.label: ocarina sings
steps.text: Ocarina: I can sing. Touch my face and I become a small instrument for breath, pitch, tuning, and play.
steps.stage: Presenter points to Ocarina speaker before the tap cue.

steps.label: ocarina tap note
steps.stage: Stage direction: tap the center of Ocarina to trigger a note.

steps.label: cameo remembers
steps.text: Cameo is the pendant form. I keep faculty voices, quotations, notes, and memory prompts near the heart.

steps.label: cameo quotes swipe
steps.stage: Stage direction: swipe Cameo toward Quotes or Notes.

steps.label: enso speaks
steps.text: Enso is for attention. I translate signal, breath, and readiness into a non-medical reflection before study, practice, or rest.

steps.label: enso calm tap
steps.stage: Stage direction: tap high on Enso to suggest a readiness check.

steps.label: luopan aligns
steps.text: Luopan is the compass variant. I care about direction, bearing, level, and the way a room teaches attention.

steps.label: ensemble answer
steps.text: $name reporting in: $role. I can be cued by the master script for speech, face changes, taps, and swipes.

steps.label: final tableau
steps.stage: All variants return to clocks for questions.
